948590f6ebdd13bb.description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
As Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare, you’ll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run.
In regulated industries, relationships are the currency, so we’re looking for a leader who already knows the buyers and the rulebook. You’ll have the mandate to win net-new logos, drive agent sales, and build the playbook and the team.
In this role, you will:
• 
Win net-new logos and drive adoption of ElevenLabs, including closing deals yourself and also building and scaling the team
• 
Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution
• 
Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment
• 
Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies
• 
Open doors through your own network of senior buyers, and turn early wins into the references the rest of the vertical will call
• 
Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one
• 
Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run
• 
Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling
• 
Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call
• 
Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations
• 
Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy
• 
Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution
Requirements:
• 
10+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 2 years leading a team.
• 
Track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles
• 
An established network of senior decision-makers in one or more of health systems, payers, or life sciences, so you can name the buyers you’d call in your first 30 days
• 
Experience building a new sales motion or playbook from scratch, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company
• 
Passion for experimenting to find the positioning and messaging that wins in market, and turn what works into the playbook
• 
Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles
• 
Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once
• 
Executive presence at C-suite and board levels
• 
Low ego and hands-on: equally at home in a C-suite briefing and in the weeds of a prospecting list or Proof of Value. Motivated by impact and growth more than title
• 
Passion for the transformative potential of voice and conversational AI

Location
 This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

The Team

Engineering - The Engineering team builds and maintains the core technologies that power our industry-leading cybersecurity products.

Job Summary

As a Principal Product Manager for the Gateway team, you will drive the strategy and development of our Portkey AI Gateway, delivering competitive capabilities that enable teams to securely route, log, and scale AI applications. You will act as a strategic advisor, partnering with cross-functional teams, AI developers, and customers to translate complex market needs into highly differentiated infrastructure products. Leveraging deep technical insights into LLM architectures and API orchestration, you will own the full product lifecycle from feature prioritization to market evangelism.

Key Responsibilities

• Take ownership of the AI gateway domain by rapidly mastering our product architecture and infrastructure layers.
• Act as a strategic advisor for cross-functional teams building and deploying scalable AI workloads.
• Correlate technical design patterns and deep customer insights to build highly differentiated engineering products.
• Utilize data analytics to monitor operational metrics like latency, token usage, and throughput for roadmaps.
• Manage day-to-day product feature sets, strategy, and prioritization for the Portkey AI Gateway.
• Drive feature prioritization and trade-off decision-making to achieve desired outcomes within stipulated timelines.
• Support New Product Introduction processes, Beta test programs, and ramp-up initiatives for new features.
• Conduct market and customer analysis to develop requirements, business cases, and product positioning.
• Maintain a strong customer focus through active engagement with customers and AI application developers.
• Collaborate with cross-functional departments to provide comprehensive support for owned feature sets.

Qualifications 

Required Qualifications

• Minimum of 8 years of proven product management experience in AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, API management, or enterprise cybersecurity.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, APIs, LLM developer tools, and enterprise developer infrastructure.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of using data to drive decisions.
• Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle and design innovative, customer-centric products.
• Experience working collaboratively in rapid-iteration agile environments with cross-functional, global teams.
• Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills for multi-disciplinary collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree, such as an MBA or equivalent, is highly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly with minimal ramp-up time.
• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to comprehend complex product requirements.
• Strong people skills and team mentality with a demonstrable track record of success.

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

94bd7bb47096e164.description: **About AptEdge** We build AI agents for B2B technical support. The agent pulls from everything a support org already has (tickets, docs, CRM, chat, bugs, codebase) and works a case the way a good senior engineer would, from investigation to resolution. We live inside the tools support teams already use: Zendesk, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack, Jira, Confluence. Backed by top VCs and Founders. **The Role** Every customer we sign has to go from contract to a working, trusted AI agent workflow, and you're the person who gets them there. You'll set up their integrations, tune what the agent can see and say, write the runbooks that tell it how that customer resolves a given class of ticket, and stay close enough afterward to know when something has drifted. Most of that is configuration. Some of it is code, and when it is, you'll write it yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting. You'll be part of our Customer Success org, because the role is evaluated on whether customers adopt, expand, and renew. You'll also spend time working with the R&D team. When you find something in a deployment that's a product problem and not a config problem, you should be able to walk over and fix it, or at least get it fixed fast. **What You'll Work On** **Getting customers live** Setting up integrations, SSO and SAML, IT and systems administration, and checking that what we’re integrated with is actually what they meant to give us. Co-ordinate with customers and admin/IT teams over calls and async to run enablement. **Customizing the product** Overall setup, prompt engineering, search filters, ranking, how answers get formatted, branding, embeds. Whatever it takes to make AptEdge feel native to that customer. **Data understanding and engineering** Sometimes it's the source data. Sometimes it's indexing, a filter, or a prompt. You'll trace it through pipelines, logs, and the database and fix the layer that's actually broken. **Technical Prompt Engineering** Work on a live LLM powered platform that empowers very technical engineers and agents to deliver business value. Understand data in depth to understand build agentic workflows and pipelines. **Writing some code** Building and fixing connectors, self-service features, ingestion for the odd knowledge sources customers throw at us, and internal tooling so the third time we do a customization it's a setting instead of a project. **Monitoring and optimizing customer health** Reporting on usage and resolution per account, alongside CS. You'll see a stalled deployment before the customer does and know how to unstick it. **Growing accounts** You'll own the technical half of expansion: scoping new use cases, discovering value, empowering business partners, and coordinating with internal go-to-market and engineering teams. **You Need** * 5+ years in solutions, implementation, and backend engineering at a B2B SaaS company * To have supported an LLM or RAG product that real customers used in production * Solid Python and TypeScript, and comfort working in a large codebase in collaboration with engineering teams * Hands-on experience with enterprise identity (SAML, OAuth2, SSO) and third-party APIs, including the ugly parts: rate limits, webhooks, eventual consistency, prompt engineering & testing * Clear written and spoken English to communicate with customers and IT/engineering teams. * Availability for customer calls through US working hours. The rest of your day is yours to arrange. * Experience with cloud and debugging tools such as GCP/AWS, Sentry, PagerDuty, etc. **It Helps If You Have** * Admin or config experience in Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or ServiceNow * Direct experience supporting live, production-grade retrieval-augmented generation systems * Background with Kubernetes or React web applications * A feel for the commercial side. You know adoption is what drives renewal, and you can tell a customer who's stuck from one who's just not using it * A habit of owning problems from beginning to end, including identifying opportunities to be proactive in support of customer or internal goals. * Previous working experience as a Support Engineer **How We Work** * Small team, high ownership. Small PRs, and we pair when a problem is hard * Customer-facing engineers ship code here. About MDOTM

MDOTM is a global leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, growing across our offices in London, Milan, and New York. We recently closed a $27M growth equity round, led by Expedition Growth Capital, to support our continued international expansion. Our proprietary platform, Sphere, currently supports over $100B in assets under management for institutional clients including Morgan Stanley, Amundi, and Zurich Bank.
Role Overview
MDOTM, a leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, is looking for an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Team. You will play a key role in supporting, enhancing, and maintaining the foundational infrastructure and tools that empower our product teams — contributing to a reliable, scalable, and efficient developer platform that enables fast and secure software delivery for Sphere, our proprietary AI-driven investment platform.
Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and automation of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases across all environments.

• Assist in the adoption and management of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible, helping provision and manage on-premise and AWS resources in a controlled, auditable, and reproducible manner.

• Work with Docker and Kubernetes to package and operate services, contributing to declarative configuration, GitOps practices, and efficient resource utilization.

• Help implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix), and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and low Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

• Contribute to embedding security best practices (OWASP Top 10, least privilege IAM, shift-left testing) into the SDLC and help automate security controls within pipelines.

• Support the management and automation of database infrastructure (MySQL, MongoDB), including provisioning, backups, and automated schema migrations.

• Automate and support the deployment, scaling, and operational health of core platform services (authentication, data pipelines, messaging) for internal consumers.

• Participate in technical design discussions, learn from architectural decisions related to infrastructure and operations, and help document runbooks and standards.

• Champion DevOps culture ("you build it, you run it") and share knowledge through demos, pair programming, and internal workshops.

Skills Required

• 1–3 years of professional experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role, with a focus on automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD

• Hands-on experience working with and contributing to CI/CD pipelines

• Practical experience with Docker and exposure to Kubernetes, including writing Dockerfiles and debugging containerized applications

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible

• Experience with at least one monitoring, logging, or alerting system (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Zabbix), and curiosity for SRE principles

• Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating common tasks

• Basic understanding of security best practices in the SDLC

• Good analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting system and infrastructure issues

• Clear English communication, collaborative spirit, and a growth mindset aligned with a culture of shared ownership and rapid feedback

Bonus points:

• Experience with event-driven systems (e.g., ActiveMQ)

• Contributions to open-source projects

• Familiarity with backend development concepts (e.g., Java/Spring Boot)

• Working knowledge of AWS fundamentals (EC2, S3, IAM)

• Financial-services or high-throughput data processing background

Why Join Us?

• Work at the leading edge of technology, leveraging our decade of experience in proprietary AI to power a platform trusted by top-tier institutional clients.

• Truly flexible work environment — we care about output, not hours logged.

• Collaborate daily with an ultra-international team (18+ nationalities) across our Milan, London, and New York offices.

• Annual company retreat at a stunning location, because we invest in our people beyond the day job.

• Real, fast-track career progression, with outsized growth opportunities for early team members.

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.
You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

Responsibilities:

• Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points

• Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
• Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

Qualifications:
• 4-6 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
• Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
• User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
• Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
• Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

Additional (Preferred):
• OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
• Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
• AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
• Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

Additional Information: Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

About Us

HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 800+ leading companies worldwide. Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years.

With a remarkable valuation of $3.1B and an impressive annual recurring revenue exceeding $100M, we experience a robust year-over-year growth of 24%.
